name: Purchase Order Report - Summary
query:
SELECT
    po.name AS 'PO No.:Link/Purchase Order:150',
    DATE_FORMAT(po.transaction_date, '%%d-%%b-%%y') AS 'PO Date:Data:100',
    po.supplier_name AS 'Supplier:Data:200',
    po.status AS 'Status:Data:100',
    po.custom_order_by AS 'Preparer:Data:120',
    po.currency AS 'Ccy:Data:50',
    po.total AS 'Total:Currency/Ccy:120',
    po.total_taxes_and_charges AS 'Tax:Currency/Ccy:100',
    po.discount_amount AS 'Disc:Currency/Ccy:100',
    po.grand_total AS 'Grand Total:Currency/Ccy:120'
FROM
    `tabPurchase Order` AS po
WHERE
    po.transaction_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
ORDER BY
    po.name ASC;
